title: Make the lib/tests gate run jail-requiring suites, and make it able to fail
objective: Unblock the push gate and CI for suites that must execute inside shell_coverage_jail.sh, and close the fail-open hole that let a suite with a failing assertion exit 0 through that gate -- without changing the jail's behaviour in the measurement mode the 105-lib shell-coverage campaign depends on.
acceptance_criteria: A suite declares its jail requirement as data (a jail_args file beside run_all.sh); neither ci_mirror.sh nor shell-tests.yml names any suite path, so a future jail-requiring suite needs no edit to either runner.
Both runners fail closed on a jail_args file that is present but empty: reported as a configuration error, never silently skipped.
Gate mode fails on a failing assertion: the features/lib suite with a deliberately broken _t_eq injected before _t_report exits non-zero.
Gate mode does not false-positive: the unmodified features/lib suite exits 0.
Measurement mode is unchanged: a subject with an error-path case that exits non-zero still reports its coverage and exits 0, so --fail-on-case-error is off by default.
The extracted jail_args flags reproduce the independently measured dot_resolver_install.sh 39/39 = 100.00%.
The five lib/tests suites that do not require the jail still run bare and pass.
Every touched shell file is within the 250-line cap and shellcheck-clean, with no suppressions added.
out_of_scope: The REFUSING guards in the individual test files: they are what stop a test run from writing the developer's real /etc, and are deliberately untouched.
Wiring check_shell_coverage.sh into any hook -- that arms only when the allowlist reaches zero.
The kcov mis-measurement of rpi_nc_install.sh, which is tracked separately as an instrument defect.
The unrelated python_pkg/token_audit/ files a concurrent session staged into the shared index.
verifier: Four quadrants via meta/scripts/shell_coverage_jail.sh: measurement+error-case = 0 with coverage printed; gate+error-case = 1; gate+clean features/lib suite = 0; gate+injected-failing-assertion = 1. Plus bash meta/scripts/check_file_length.sh --all showing no violation, shellcheck on the three shell files, and a successful git push through the ci-mirror pre-push hook.
